question: Fill in the blank (4) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**all**" is used to refer to the entirety of the specified sectors. (सभी)
 
• In the context of the passage,** it implies that sustainable practices must be adopted across the entire span of sectors in the economy, leaving no sector behind.**
 
• The other options: "**every**," "**some**," and "**any**" do not provide the same sense of completeness as "all" does.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** To combat climate change, we must reduce our carbon footprint by transitioning to renewable energy sources, conserving forests, and adopting sustainable practices in all__ the sectors of the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Every (प्रत्येक)**: Used to refer to each individual item or person set within a group.
 
• **Some (कुछ)**: Used to refer to an unspecified amount or number.
 
• **Any (कोई)**: Used to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.
